item.title: Show HN: Book Studio – Turn PDFs into a private reading library
item.summary: I’ve been converting PDF books into web documents for my own reading. Splitting them into chapters, searching for specific passages, and adding highlights and notes felt much more convenient than using a standard PDF viewer. I organized this setup into a template called Book Studio so others can use it too. Built on Fumadocs, it provides a modern, docs-style reading experience. It includes an agent skill that imports PDFs as chapter-based MDX, along with search, highlights, notes, and reading-position tracking. Authentication is handled with passkeys. You can deploy your own copy from the template using Vercel and Neon. If you’ve wanted to turn PDFs into a personal reading environment, give it a try.
